name: Family Sponsorship — Spouse/Partner/Dependent Children

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being the spouse, common-law partner, conjugal partner, or dependent child of a Canadian citizen or permanent resident. NO minimum income is required from the sponsor for this category, unlike parent/grandparent sponsorship.
This requires the sponsor to sign a 3-year undertaking of financial support.

evidence_required.document: Marriage/partnership certificate or evidence of genuine relationship

outcome.duration_length: indefinite — direct PR grant, no conditional PR

sources.title: Sponsor your spouse, partner or child - IRCC

notes: CONFIRMED: no conditional PR for spousal sponsorship — this was repealed in 2017, and Canada has NOT reintroduced it as of this verification. A person sponsored as a spouse cannot sponsor a NEW spouse for 5 years — a real, specific anti-fraud restriction worth flagging. NO income requirement for this category — a genuine and confirmed structural simplicity distinct from ca_family_sponsorship_pgp's Minimum Necessary Income test, worth surfacing prominently as a real difference within Canada's own family-immigration system. Direct PR grant (pr_after_months: 0), same structural pattern as Express Entry — Canada's family and economic PR routes both largely avoid the temporary-then-PR staging common in Europe.
